scope: Public evidence metadata only; no biological sequences, hardware control, fabrication or in-vivo intervention

records.observed: One gene-edited porcine kidney supported dialysis independence for 271 days before graft failure and nephrectomy.
limitations: Single participant with specific immunosuppression
Graft microvascular injury and thrombotic microangiopathy
Does not demonstrate de novo formation of an organ inside a donor animal
records.safe_next_step: Represent graft function decline and a hard-stop alert on recorded synthetic time series

records.observed: Human kidney organoid-derived cells were detected 24 to 48 hours after porcine kidney ex vivo perfusion and autologous reimplantation.
limitations: Short follow-up
Presence of human cells is not proof of a mature functional organ
Not demonstrated with actinomycetes or remote commands
records.safe_next_step: Build synthetic cell-persistence observation model with uncertainty intervals

records.observed: Batteryless wireless readout of a bacteria-associated passive device from 25 mm inside a body tissue phantom.
limitations: Not implanted in living mammals
Readout, not general bidirectional remote reprogramming
Device was not based on actinomycetes
records.safe_next_step: Use public readout observations as a model for packet-loss stress tests with entirely synthetic sensor values

records.observed: A bioelectrochemical study reported physiological responses of Streptomyces lividans in laboratory culture.
limitations: Not evidence of a deployable implant
Not evidence of tissue reprogramming
Not evidence of growing an organ in a donor animal
records.safe_next_step: Catalog response observables without extrapolating laboratory physiology to animal outcomes

records.observed: An electroactive microbial co-culture was used as a modular whole-cell bioelectronic sensor.
limitations: Published sensing is not a clinical implant
No actinomycete-driven organogenesis
No remote control of mammalian tissue assembly
records.safe_next_step: Represent a read-only multichannel virtual sensor and inject dropout faults

records.observed: OpenAI and Ginkgo reported a GPT-5/robotics feedback loop for cell-free protein synthesis: more than 36,000 reaction compositions over 580 plates, 40% reduction in protein production cost.
limitations: Cell-free protein production rather than organ growth
Does not establish an OpenAI-Red Queen-LANL joint implant program
Laboratory platform access not granted to this assistant
records.safe_next_step: Model evidence provenance and reversible simulated experiment selection only

records.observed: ARPA-H announced funded performers pursuing structured adult neocortex graft research; no completed human graft is substantiated here.
limitations: Program award is not proof of success
No applicability to actinomycete-derived anthropomorphic organ construction
records.safe_next_step: Track public program milestones separately from peer-reviewed experimental outcomes

records.observed: ARPA-H announced five selected performer teams for developing bioprinted immunologically matched human organs; these are research awards, not finished transplants.
limitations: No reported completed bioprinted adult organ from this program in this announcement
Separate from remotely commanded actinomycetes and in-vivo organ formation
records.safe_next_step: Record milestone evidence and its validation type for each awardee without issuing fabrication commands
